title: Neural control of choroidal blood flow
publisher: Progress in Retinal and Eye Research
verification: Full citation and complete abstract read directly on Europe PMC 2026-10-27 (cited by 304): the choroid is richly innervated by parasympathetic, sympathetic and trigeminal sensory fibres that regulate choroidal blood flow; parasympathetic vasodilates, sympathetic vasoconstricts, sensory fibres convey pain/thermal information and act locally to vasodilate; impairments occur with aging, glaucoma, AMD, hypertension, diabetes.
